audit_method.selection: All non-empty local_logic_observations whose logic is AND, OR, unknown, or unresolved_and_or in the consolidated 281-event AI-authorized review.
audit_method.source_join: fault_code matched to weak_record.fault_code in the public corpus.
audit_method.quote_check: Count exact literal occurrences of the observation quote in that sample input_text.
audit_method.offset_check: When offsets exist, compare input_text[start:end] to quote; offsets use 0-based, end-exclusive positions.
audit_method.scope_rule: local_gate is not copied to event_gate; each observation retains both labels and its original review scope.
